violations.text: The ceiling in the basement area was observed unfinished (insulation misaligned and falling). The physical facilities to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 01/30/2027

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Wood is used in the construction of several areas in the kitchen area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026
The door to the gender neutral toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026
Several floor tiles in the prep area were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Several ceiling tiles near the kitchen hood were observed in poor repair. The ceiling in this area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment.
